items.text: Feeling isn't required. Pressing delete needs no emotion. Just say the words plainly, and the replay loosens.
The more you search for the reason, the longer the same film runs. Set it down with "I don't know," and offer one word.

patterns: i'm not the one who's wrong
items.text: This isn't about forgiving them. It's about releasing the memory replaying in you. You don't have to change them.
"I want results" is a replay too. Release the outcome and watch; something arrives from outside the expectation.

patterns: too hard to say all of them
it's exhausting to say all of them
items.text: One word is enough. "I love you" or "Thank you" alone carries the rest.
Anytime, anywhere. Like breathing, as a daily habit.
